quarterly_data.signal: Magnachip's 10-K customer concentration: sales to SAMT Co., Ltd. (SAMT) represented 29.7% of net sales from its Power Solutions business in 2025 (25.4% in 2024); its ten largest customers accounted for 74.3% of Power Solutions net sales in 2025 (73.4% in 2024), and products were sold to 185 end customers (165 in 2024). By billing location, 2025 revenue was $5.0 million from U.S. customers and $173.9 million from all foreign countries, of which 50.6% from Korea and 36.9% from Greater China.
